description: Fork only (see FORK.md): enforce the feature loop when the repo (or its main worktree) has .scratch/gates.json without status closed. PreToolUse on Bash, PowerShell and MCP tools (matcher anchored) gates git commit (slop in the staged lines), git push and PR creation (build-phase gates; pushes to the base branch refused) and gh pr merge or a GraphQL mergePullRequest (match-head-commit, merge-phase gates, green CI on that sha, HEAD equal to that sha); a PowerShell call that mentions git or gh is refused and sent to Bash, an MCP merge tool is refused, and the MCP tools that create a PR or write a branch are gated like gh and git; fails closed while a loop is active. Stop refuses to end a turn while a stage is running. SessionStart summarizes where the loop stands.
